name: settings-native-window
description: the settings window looks like macOS System Settings with Native app view off. The gate is the line only the settings window's vibrancy install emits. The page must wear native mode, keep html and the sidebar column transparent so the sidebar vibrancy shows, paint the content column opaque in the pushed system window colour, and lift its group cards off that ground. The captures are for the eye: sidebar blur, opaque content, no stripe at either side. settings-native-window-dark is the dark sibling. The run ends with a live switch to dark, and the open window must follow it.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
Atrium frontmost, so the chord reaches it
no vlog wait, so the capture below starts before the page is ready
the window's first frames, before the theme push: no white or black flash
gate: the native settings window was created

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.documentElement; const clear = (el) => !!el && getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; return r.classList.contains('atrium-native-chrome') && clear(r) && clear(document.body) && clear(document.querySelector('.settings-sidebar')); })()
actions.note: THE MEASUREMENT: native with the mode off, and nothing opaque above the vibrancy in the sidebar column

actions.expression: (() => { const hex = document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color'); if (!/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/.test(hex)) { return false; } const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16); const c = [n >> 16, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]; const want = 'rgb(' + c.join(', ') + ')'; return getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.settings-body')).backgroundColor === want && Math.max(...c) - Math.min(...c) <= 4; })()
actions.note: THE MEASUREMENT: the content column is opaque in the pushed system colour, and that colour is a neutral grey, not the blue-grey glass

actions.expression: (() => { const px = (s) => { const n = (s.match(/[\d.]+/g) || []).map(Number); const c = s.startsWith('color(') ? n.slice(0, 3).map((v) => v * 255) : n.slice(0, 3); return 0.2126 * c[0] + 0.7152 * c[1] + 0.0722 * c[2]; }; const g = document.querySelector('.settings-group'); const b = document.querySelector('.settings-body'); const h = document.querySelector('.settings-heading'); if (!g || !b || !h) { return false; } const ground = px(getComputedStyle(b).backgroundColor); return Math.abs(px(getComputedStyle(g).backgroundColor) - ground) >= 5 && Math.abs(px(getComputedStyle(h).color) - ground) >= 100; })()
actions.note: the group cards lift off the ground by a visible step, and the heading ink contrasts with it

actions.expression: (() => { const cs = (s, p) => { const el = document.querySelector(s); return el ? getComputedStyle(el)[p] : 'none'; }; return 'surround=' + document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color') + ' body=' + cs('.settings-body', 'backgroundColor') + ' card=' + cs('.settings-group', 'backgroundColor') + ' ink=' + cs('.settings-heading', 'color') + ' dark=' + matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches; })()
actions.note: recorded: the numbers behind the checks above

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.getElementById('atrium-root').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.left === 0 && Math.round(r.width) === document.documentElement.clientWidth; })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="appearance"]'); if (!b) { return 'no-pane'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: a pane full of controls, for the eye

actions.expression: (() => { const snap = () => { const cs = (sel, prop) => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(sel))[prop]; return { scheme: matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches, surround: document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color'), body: cs('.settings-body', 'backgroundColor'), ink: cs('.settings-heading', 'color') }; }; window.__liveBefore = snap(); return JSON.stringify(window.__liveBefore); })()
actions.note: recorded: the light values the live switch must move
macOS goes dark with the settings window open, no relaunch

actions.expression: (() => { const snap = () => { const cs = (sel, prop) => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(sel))[prop]; return { scheme: matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches, surround: document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color'), body: cs('.settings-body', 'backgroundColor'), ink: cs('.settings-heading', 'color') }; }; const a = snap(); const b = window.__liveBefore; if (!b) { return 'no-before'; } return 'dark=' + a.scheme + ' ' + ['surround', 'body', 'ink'].map((k) => k + '=' + (a[k] !== b[k])).join(' '); })()
actions.note: THE MEASUREMENT: the renderer scheme, the pushed ground, the content column and the ink all follow the live switch

assertions.label: no-dark-flash-at-first-paint
assertions.desc: the blank strip above the heading stays light in every frame. The light ground is white, so only a black or grey flash can show here

assertions.note: the browser window and the settings window

assertions.desc: settings is native with the mode off, and the sidebar column is see-through
the content column is opaque in a neutral system colour
the group cards and the text read on the ground
the settings root fills the window
a live switch to dark re-colours the open window
